summary: Frontend testing completed for P0 (hardware type search and badges) and P1 (Casco Predeterminado por Serie) features. All 6 test cases passed successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Hardware search implementation in BudgetTable.jsx is well-structured with hardwareSearchTerms and specialSearchTerms mappings
getHardwareType and getSpecialType helper functions correctly detect hardware codes from product codes
Casco Predeterminado por Serie section properly iterates through all product series from catalogs
Save functionality for default carcass settings uses proper API endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 and P1 features are fully functional. Hardware type search (hl, hs, servo, lift, horno, micro) works correctly. Hardware badges (HL blue, HS green) are visible in product library. Settings > Armazones > Casco Predeterminado por Serie section shows all 64 product series with dropdown selectors for default carcass material.

details: Search 'hl' returns products with LIFT/HL in name
Search 'hs' returns products with SERVO-DRIVE/HS in name
Same products as 'hs' search are displayed
HL badge (blue) visible next to LIFT products
HS badge (green) visible next to SERVO-DRIVE products
Badges appear after product name in library list
Settings > Armazones tab accessible via MASTER button
Section shows description: 'Configura qué armazón usar automáticamente para cada serie de productos'
64 product series displayed with dropdown selectors
Series include: ALTO 110 FONDO 33, ALTO 110 FONDO 58, ALTO 110 FONDO ESTANDAR, etc.
Each selector has options: Sin predeterminado, ROBLE HERCULES 19 MM, BLANCO TITANIO 19 MM, BLANCO SOFT 16 mms., BLANCO HIDROFUGO SOFT
Selection can be changed and saved via 'Guardar Cascos por Serie' button
